node.title: Combining multiple =~ s/
node.author: hennesse
node.doctext:
I sometimes have to do this: $string =~ s/zero/0/ig; $string =~ s/one/1/ig; $string =~ s/two/2/ig; $string =~ s/three/3/ig;

This is cool if there are just a few, but not if a lot. Is there a more compact way to do this?

i.e. I need a "trans-word-ilation" operator, similar to the "transliteration" opeerator

Thanks - Dave
